entities.name: Obyra
entities.description: Famed Faerie duelist and princess, daughter of Talion, with a magic rapier made from a spindle of golden thread.

entities.name: Beauty, Song, and Blessing
entities.description: Obyra's attendants who tried to keep her out of trouble.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: Curse that expanded to encapsulate the realm and afflicted Obyra.

events.summary: The Wicked Slumber expands to encapsulate the realm and Obyra is afflicted by the curse.
events.quote: she was afflicted by the curse

events.summary: Asleep, Obyra roams Eldraine seeking other duelists while her attendants try to keep her out of trouble.
events.quote: she roamed Eldraine seeking other duelists even while asleep

events.summary: Obyra presumably awakes after the curse is broken.
events.quote: Obyra presumably awoke after the curse was broken.

relations.quote: Obyra is a daughter of the fae lord Talion
